# Derek Holt of Alerus named Business Leader to Watch in 2027


##### November 23, 2026


Derek Holt, Alerus senior vice president and Arizona market president, has been named a 2027 Business Leader to Watch by Az Business magazine, recognizing him as one of Arizona’s banking leaders to watch in the year ahead.


Derek leads Alerus’ commercial and industrial banking team in Arizona, providing business clients with personalized banking services and access to Alerus’ broader financial solutions. With more than 20 years of financial services experience, he brings deep expertise in commercial banking, consumer lending, and team leadership.


Learn more about Derek and the 2027 Business Leaders to Watch in the November/December issue of Az Business magazine,[available online.](https://azbigmedia.com/publication/azbusiness/)
